$comment: Icon categories, in resolution order: an icon belongs to the first category whose `match` pattern (a JavaScript regular expression) matches its base name, which is the name with any square- or circle- container prefix removed. A name no pattern matches is in `other`. `icon` is the drawing that represents the category in a browser. `blurb` says what is in it. Source, not generated: edit this file. Extracted from Keyline's lib/icon-taxonomy.ts and the site's category rail when the site was removed.

categories.label: AI

categories.label: Finance

categories.label: Media

categories.label: Charts

categories.label: Diagrams
